- Freeze at 75%: about 2.

- Width cut: about 0.7 (bad).

- Per-seed std about 0.3 pp; 3-seed SE about 0.17 pp; 10-seed SE about 0.1 pp.
- Time noise about 1%.
- A committed recipe reproduces bit-identically on re-run.

- Architecture of group-1 conv1 at 31×31, for example stride or an earlier pool.
- Batch size per phase (H5.1.3).
- Converting saved time into accuracy through steps.

- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.

W3 (cost lens), after E038.

**Tip (E036).** 231 steps at batch 2000. Resolutions 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30% of steps. Stem frozen at 75% and whitening output detached from 20% of steps. Measured 5.314 s and 0.7532 on seeds 0–2.

**What E038 adds.** On fresh seeds 13–22 the tip scores 0.7525, so the pooled mean is about 0.7525–0.753. The winner's curse on seeds 3–12 was small, but the tip sits at the bar with no margin. Every further time cut must be paid for in accuracy first, or must be accuracy-neutral. The 40-seed official bar of 0.75 still has about 0.25 pp of headroom.

**Code facts:**
- Muon renormalizes filters and has no wd, so filter wd is inert.
- Newton-Schulz runs 3 iterations.
- Group-1 BN runs at 15×15 after the pool. The large-map work is conv1's 31×31×128 output and the pool.
- The whitening has no backward after 20% of steps.

**Time budget.** Time ≈ F (about 0.25 s) + Σ steps × per-step cost.
- Per step: about 0.032 s at 32 px, 0.026 at 28, 0.021 at 24, 0.016 at 20, minus the detach and freeze savings.
- 0.5 epoch ≈ 0.3 s.
- Memory-bound savings came in at or above face value in every run (E028, E031, E034, E036, E037). My time forecasts hit in 7 runs in a row once I priced this in.
- MAC split: group 1 about 20%, group 2 about 51%, group 3 about 29%. E028 implies group 1 is about 35–40% of step time.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost):**
- Epoch dial: 1.5–2.5.
- Freeze at 75%: about 2.
- Early low resolution: 1–2.
- Whitening detach: ≥1.
- Freeze 75%→60%: about 0.65 (bad).
- Width cut: about 0.7 (bad).
- Loss-based dropping: about 2.

**Accuracy boosters.** Every schedule and regularization tweak was ≤0 on held-out seeds (E025, E029, E030, E032). Prior for untested ones: −0.2 ± 0.25 pp. Only steps and Muon reliably buy accuracy. Muon's share is still confounded with batch size and the RNG re-draw.

**Mechanisms:**
1. Lookahead averaging is worth about 1 pp and is already tuned (E005, E025, E030).
2. Muon is worth about 0.3–0.6 pp at about 3% time (E006).
3. Accuracy is built at 28/32 px and needs a trainable stem through about 75% of steps (E011, E018, E024, E033, E037).
4. Large-map backward is bandwidth-bound (E028, E034, E036).
5. An RNG re-draw moves the 3-seed mean by ±0.1–0.3 pp (E035).

**Noise:**
- Per-seed std about 0.3 pp; 3-seed SE about 0.17 pp; 10-seed SE about 0.1 pp.
- Time noise about 1%.
- A committed recipe reproduces bit-identically on re-run.

**Remaining budget.** BN folding at 15×15 in the frozen phase is worth ≤1%, because the statistics are computed on small maps for only 25% of steps. Dropping Muon saves about 2–3% but probably costs ≥0.3 pp, which is a bad rate given zero margin. The remaining real levers:
- Architecture of group-1 conv1 at 31×31, for example stride or an earlier pool.
- Batch size per phase (H5.1.3).
- Converting saved time into accuracy through steps.

**Unsure:**
- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.
- Whether any accuracy booster exists at all.
- Muon's unconfounded value.

forecasts.reason: Group-1 BN runs at 15×15 after the pool and only in the last 25% of steps, so folding saves under 1% (0.02–0.04 s), well short of the 2% claimed. The eval-mode BN switch plus the RNG re-draw adds accuracy noise.
No recipe change, so the recorded metrics should reproduce the tip. E028's 27% per-step saving implies group 1 plus whitening take about 35–40% of the step and non-GEMM kernels take at least 30%.
With 3 Newton-Schulz iterations, Muon costs about 2–3% of step time. SGD at batch 2000 with ported lr scaling likely loses at least 0.3 pp, so it fails the bar.

cruxes: Does any time-neutral change raise the held-out mean by ≥0.2 pp? The tip's pooled mean of about 0.7528 has no margin, so every remaining time cut depends on bought-back accuracy.
How much of step time is group-1 conv1 plus the pool at 31×31 (I058 profile)? That share sets whether a stem architecture change (stride or earlier pool) is the last ≥5% lever.
Is Muon worth ≥0.3 pp unconfounded? If not, dropping it is about 2–3% free time.
